title.narrative: CIUDAD MUJER
Ciudad Mujer

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Proyecto es mejorar las condiciones de vida de las mujeres de 15 aos o ms de edad en Honduras en trminos de su participacin laboral, salud sexual y reproductiva, prevencin y atencin a la violencia contra las mujeres, y prevencin del embarazo en adolescentes. Los objetivos especficos para los departamentos objetivo son: (i) incrementar el porcentaje de mujeres mayores a 15 aos de edad que participan en la fuerza laboral; (ii) reducir la tasa de mortalidad materna y por cncer de mama y crvico-uterino en mujeres de 15 aos o ms; (iii) reducir la prevalencia de violencia (fsica o sexual ejercida por la pareja y homicidios) contra mujeres de 15 aos o ms; (iv) reducir la tasa del embarazo en adolescentes de 15 a 19 aos; y (v) ampliar la cobertura de la atencin especializada e integrada para las mujeres de 15 aos o ms mediante la creacin yo fortalecimiento de Centros Ciudad Mujer en los departamentos de Francisco Morazn, Corts, Olancho y Atlntida

The general objective is to improve the living conditions of Honduran women aged 15 and older in terms of labor force participation, sexual and reproductive health, prevention of and response to violence against women, and prevention of adolescent pregnancy. The specific objectives for the target departments are to: (i) increase the percentage of women aged 15 and older who are participating in the labor force; (ii) reduce the maternal mortality rate and the breast cancer and cervical-uterine cancer mortality rates in women aged 15 and older; (iii) reduce the prevalence of violence (physical or sexual violence committed by a partner, as well as homicides) against women aged 15 and older; (iv) reduce the pregnancy rate among adolescents aged 15 to 19; and (v) expand the coverage of specialized and integrated services for women aged 15 and older by creating andor strengthening Ciudad Mujer Centers in the departments of Francisco Morazn, Corts, Olancho, and Atlntida.
